## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete issue and what a user observes after this change.

## Validation

List commands and results, affected platforms, and material checks not run.
For behavior fixes, include a regression test that fails without the fix.

## Review notes

Describe security/authorization, route/firewall ownership, compatibility, or migration implications when relevant. Link updated user documentation. Confirm that fixtures, logs, and screenshots contain no credentials or personal account/device data.
